text: Westport Albion advances along the right flank, pushing into Kingsmoor FC’s defensive third near the opponent’s penalty area at the far end. Their direct, vertical passes quickly connect several players moving forward, culminating in Rafael Delacroix rising centrally to head the ball toward goal just beyond the 45-minute mark. The keeper reacts to save the downward header, marking Westport’s growing control in this midfield and attacking zone. The teams remain level at 2-2, with Westport putting strong pressure on Kingsmoor’s right side. [#862]
